stem: A bimetallic strip is made of aluminium and steel $(\alpha_{\mathrm{Al}} > \alpha_{\mathrm{steel}})$. On heating, the strip will

stem: An aluminium sphere is dipped into water. Which of the following is true?
options: Buoyancy will be less in water at $0^\circ\mathrm{C}$ than that in water at $4^\circ\mathrm{C}$.

decreases as its effective length increases even though its centre of mass still remains at the centre of the bob.
